# Sysctl

Kernel parameters, written to sysctl.d files and applied.
`osapi behavior get --name sysctl` and `osapi behavior method get` show the
same. [Its chain](../../chains/sysctl.md) shows each call that its examples
make.

## Method list

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | list                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Description | List the kernel's parameters and which osapi manages                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Detail      | Lists every parameter the kernel shows under /proc/sys, with its current value, as sysctl -a does, and marks the ones osapi manages. A prefix, such as net.ipv4, limits the list to that part of the tree. The kernel can lack a parameter that osapi manages, for example when its module is not loaded. Then the list shows the value that osapi wrote. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/sysctl                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Permission  | sysctl:read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Command     | [osapi client node sysctl list](../../../usage/cli/client/node/sysctl/list.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Input type  | ListInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Output type | []Entry                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

### Input (1)

| FIELD  | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                          | DESCRIPTION                                                 |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| prefix | string | no       | pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$ | Only this parameter and the ones under it, such as net.ipv4 |

### Output (3)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                                 |
| ------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| key     | string  | Parameter name                                              |
| value   | string  | Current runtime value                                       |
| managed | boolean | Whether osapi manages it: a file of its own sets it at boot |

### Examples (3)

| EXAMPLE                                                | INPUT             | OUTPUT                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Every parameter, and which osapi manages               | prefix=           | [key=kernel.panic, managed=false, value=0] [key=net.ipv4.ip_forward, managed=true, value=1] [key=net.ipv4.ping_group_range, managed=false, value=0 2147483647] |
| One part of the tree                                   | prefix=net.ipv4   | [key=net.ipv4.ip_forward, managed=true, value=1] [key=net.ipv4.ping_group_range, managed=false, value=0 2147483647]                                            |
| A managed parameter the kernel does not have right now | prefix=net.bridge | [key=net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables, managed=true, value=1]                                                                                                |

## Method get

|             |                                                                              |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | get                                                                          |
| Verb        | read                                                                         |
| Description | Get a kernel parameter's current value, and whether osapi manages it         |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                          |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/sysctl/&#123;key&#125;                        |
| Permission  | sysctl:read                                                                  |
| Command     | [osapi client node sysctl get](../../../usage/cli/client/node/sysctl/get.md) |
| Input type  | GetInput                                                                     |
| Output type | Entry                                                                        |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                        | DESCRIPTION                                 |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| key   | string | yes      | pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$, min length 1 | Parameter name, such as net.ipv4.ip_forward |

### Output (3)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                                 |
| ------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| key     | string  | Parameter name                                              |
| value   | string  | Current runtime value                                       |
| managed | boolean | Whether osapi manages it: a file of its own sets it at boot |

### Examples (4)

| EXAMPLE                                                | INPUT                                  | OUTPUT                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A parameter osapi manages                              | key=vm.swappiness                      | key=vm.swappiness, value=10, managed=true                        |
| A parameter osapi does not manage                      | key=vm.swappiness                      | key=vm.swappiness, value=60, managed=false                       |
| A value of several fields                              | key=net.ipv4.ping_group_range          | key=net.ipv4.ping_group_range, value=0 2147483647, managed=false |
| A managed parameter the kernel does not have right now | key=net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables | key=net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables, value=1, managed=true    |

## Method create

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | create                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Description | Manage a kernel parameter and apply it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Detail      | Writes osapi-net.ipv4.ip_forward.conf for net.ipv4.ip_forward to behaviors.sysctl.dir, /etc/sysctl.d by default, and applies it with sysctl -p. It fails when sysctl -p fails, because the value is not set. A second run with the same value changes nothing and reports changed: false. If the kernel has a different value, for example after a failed apply, it applies the value again. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/sysctl                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Permission  | sysctl:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Command     | [osapi client node sysctl create](../../../usage/cli/client/node/sysctl/create.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Input type  | CreateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Output type | MutationResult                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

### Input (2)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                        | DESCRIPTION                                 |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| key   | string | yes      | pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$, min length 1 | Parameter name, such as net.ipv4.ip_forward |
| value | string | yes      | pattern ^[^\r\n]*$                                 | Value to set                                |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| key     | string  | Parameter name           |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (1)

| EXAMPLE               | INPUT                            | OUTPUT                                |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Turn on IP forwarding | key=net.ipv4.ip_forward, value=1 | key=net.ipv4.ip_forward, changed=true |

## Method delete

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Name        | delete                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Description | Stop the management of a kernel parameter                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Detail      | Removes the file that osapi wrote for it and reloads with sysctl --system. Then a setting for the key in a different file takes effect. If there is no such setting, the parameter keeps its current value until the next reboot. A delete of a parameter that osapi does not manage reports changed: false. |
| HTTP        | DELETE                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/sysctl/&#123;key&#125;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Permission  | sysctl:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Command     | [osapi client node sysctl delete](../../../usage/cli/client/node/sysctl/delete.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Input type  | DeleteInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Output type | MutationResult                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

### Input (1)

| FIELD | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                        | DESCRIPTION                                 |
| ----- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| key   | string | yes      | pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$, min length 1 | Parameter name, such as net.ipv4.ip_forward |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| key     | string  | Parameter name           |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (3)

| EXAMPLE                                    | INPUT             | OUTPUT                           |
| ------------------------------------------ | ----------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Remove a parameter                         | key=vm.swappiness | key=vm.swappiness, changed=true  |
| A parameter osapi does not manage          | key=vm.swappiness | key=vm.swappiness, changed=false |
| A parameter osapi already stopped managing | key=vm.swappiness | key=vm.swappiness, changed=false |
